name: Urmia Lake Bridge
facts: The Urmia Lake Bridge, completed in November 2008, stretches 1,276 meters across Lake Urmia, making it Iran's longest and largest bridge, a milestone achieved under President Mahmoud Ahmadinejad.
Its central 100‑meter main span, a 20.1‑meter‑high tied‑arch, allows ships to pass beneath, while nine additional spans on each side complete the 19‑span structure.
Synthetic Aperture Radar data revealed a peak consolidation rate of 90 mm/year in 2012–2013, warning that continued uneven settlement could threaten the causeway's integrity.
